exposure: location of Pg within placental and/or umbilical cord sections
outcome: Presence and location of Pg within placental and umbilical cord sections
Association with specific preterm delivery diagnoses
cohort: Archived placental and umbilical cord specimens from preterm (25 to 32 weeks gestation) and term control cohorts
finding: The presence of Pg within the villous stroma or umbilical cord may be an important determinant in Pg-associated adverse pregnancy outcomes, specifically preeclampsia.
mod_finding: The presence of Pg within the placenta was significantly associated with delivery via caesarean section.
gest_age: Preterm (25 to 32 weeks gestation) and term
